Dear IITM Support Team,

I am writing to bring to your attention the significant technical difficulties I faced during the completion of my BPT1 tasks. These issues severely impacted my ability to meet the deadline, and I kindly request you to consider my submission despite the delay.

I received the BPT1 release notification on 6th October, as outlined in the email from the System Command team. I understand that the deadline for submission was extended to 12th October. Unfortunately, due to persistent technical issues with accessing the course VM and running the BPT tasks, I was unable to complete my work on time. Despite these challenges, I submitted my solutions on the night of 13th October.

The problems I encountered included:

  • Frequent disconnections from the course VM, making it difficult to save progress.
  • Delays in accessing directories and files, which slowed down my workflow.
  • Execution failures when running the required tasks, particularly for BPT1_problem_2, which took additional time to resolve.

I have been diligent in working through these issues and finally managed to complete the tasks, albeit a bit late. Given the circumstances, I request that my submission be considered for evaluation.

Please let me know if further details are required, and I would greatly appreciate your understanding in this matter.

Thank you for your time and support.

Best regards,
Derrick Samuel R
